*Local guidance (Des Moines CDSS, Inpatient):*
Standard and Transmission Based Isolation
Standard (white): Wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for all patients when you anticipate exposure to blood and body fluids.
Contact (green): Use for patients with c diff diarrhea/herpes zoster with drainage/colonized or active infection of MRSA/ ESBL or multi drug resistant bacteria.
Strict/Special (red): Use for patient colonized or infected with VRE or VRSA.
Airborne Infection (pink): Use for patients with active or rule out TB disseminated herpes zoster/measles/chicken pox or small pox.
Droplet Precautions (yellow): Use for patients with influenza pertussis/diptheria/epiglottitis/meningococcal disease or respiratory systemic Haemophillis Influenza.
Protective Isolation (blue): Use for any immunicompromised patient/hand hygiene prior to entering room and do not care for this patient if you are sick.
